title: Hindi Ito Marites: Easing tensions between the Philippines and China
summary: The maritime dispute between Manila and Beijing doesn't have to define the totality of bilateral ties

blocks.text: The maritime dispute between Manila and Beijing doesn't have to define the totality of bilateral ties
A resolution to the West Philippine Sea dispute is nowhere on the horizon, but does this really have to drive a wedge into ties between the Philippines and China?

University of the Philippines political science professor Enrico Gloria, with a graduate degree from Beijing’s Tsinghua University, doesn’t think so. He tells Rappler editor-at-large Marites Vitug: it’s a matter of delicate but determined diplomacy. – Rappler.com
